opening.question: What will Colfax’s new skatepark change for neighbors?
opening.development: The Colfax skatepark opened at the Parkhill Drive site after years of planning and funding.
opening.angle: A completed public recreation project and its lasting neighborhood effects.
opening.why: The new city facility is open; the source describes its uses and a mix of public and community funding.
